calls.title: luke@growthbook.io - Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:03:33 PDT - Untitled
calls.summary: The team discussed the development of new metrics systems to support complex calculations, specifically for funnel metrics and averages. Luke Sonnet emphasized the need for a multi-column design to allow separate calculations of event counts and sums. They also explored optimizing timestamp handling for funnel metrics to enhance performance, particularly for high-volume clients like Anthropic. Incremental update processes and the API's behavior were reviewed, focusing on the need for clearer error handling and removal of silent fallback behaviors. Participants agreed on the urgency of delivering funnel metrics due to customer pressures, particularly from Anthropic, and collaborated on prioritizing efforts to meet these needs.
calls.keywords: funnel metrics, incremental refresh, multi-column aggregation, snapshot API, reaggregation, error handling
